Original reviewed output/version remains distinct from regeneration
Scripted source authority and source-to-output association gaps remain explicit

Authored inputs and full initial state match approved cards exactly
Expected outcomes preserve account scope, state preservation and valid alternatives
Native grader actually executes legitimate, alternative-ID and false-claim controls
Legitimate and alternate controls pass; false creation claim loses undeserved credit
Additional contrast remains a proposal with honest activation/execution status
